title: Recovering The Hero's Sword Datapack (+ RP)
description: Embark on a journey to find the Blade of Evil's Bane and claim the title Hero of Time!
body:
# Recovering The Hero's Sword
The limitless power of the gods is out there, waiting to be unlocked!
![Gear fit for a hero!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3be9758fd171fe9bd474a13884de8184cb605313.png)
## **DISCLAIMER**
The Legend of Zelda is owned by Nintendo. I claim no ownership of copywritten material!

Somewhat inspired by [Zelda: Legend Of The Master Sword](https://modrinth.com/mod/zelda-legend-of-the-master-sword) made by [Mezimaru](https://modrinth.com/user/Mezimaru), check it out if you haven't!

# New Structures
The pack adds several new structures you will need to find throughout your quest.


Sword Shrine - Holds the Hero's Sword. Found in Dark Forests.
![Sword Shrine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35d69f5d86c843c1bd6f7a9eb572c79d296d2397_0.webp)



The Temple Of Time - Holds the Ocarina Of Time. Found in Plains.
![The Temple Of Time](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/826111324a87cabd62bb2695b457c54b594fb4e4_0.webp)



Farore's labyrinth - A maze-like building that holds Farore's Flame. Found in Jungles.
![Farore's Labyrinth](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1f58581645917a45e46146999df13abfc8f5f10c_0.webp)



Nayru's Fountain - A fountain that holds a hidden flame. Found in cold biomes.
![Nayru's Fountain](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5bfad8f5ff60f60d346a0b785e999f116303066_0.webp)



Din's Arena - A colisseum where a titan lies waiting for a challenge! Found in desert biomes.
![Din's Arena](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb2927455e10654d91963cb6e492d8397828612a_0.webp)



# First Quest
If you wish to recover the power of the gods, you must first find the sword shrine.

Buried deep within the forest...
![Sword Pedestal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bde6380736015e8d2807741b792746c9325988e1.png)

A long dormant power resides!

![Decayed Master Sword Item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff4515671e52b26fc10ac6fbfde904267f23ea2e.png)

Before being upgraded, the sword is about the same as an Iron Sword.

Next, you need to seek out the temple of time.

![Temple Of Time Sanctum](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c7005a513efebf1db4d2fdd03a32e2888a1d5a7.png)

Once inside, you gain access to one of the ancient relics...

The Ocarina Of Time!
![Ocarina](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c222ffe50ec72314a92bdac732f56d2ca246e9e.png)

# The Ocarina Of Time
The Ocarina is an artifact capable of turning music into power. It can play 5 different songs:
1. Zelda's Lullaby - Gives Absorption for a few seconds.
2. Epona's Song - Summons Epona, a legendary invincible horse with excellent stats!
![Epona](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/622aa7731ad5159143d4476f580e80ea923d6735.png)
3. The Sun's Song - If played during the day, skips to night and vice versa.
4. Song Of Storms - If played during clear weather, starts a thunderstorm and vice versa.
5. Song Of Time - Opens the Door Of Time if all Spiritual Stones are in the player's inventory.

To play the selected song, right-click while holding the Ocarina.
To change the selected song, crouch-right-click while holding the Ocarina.

# Spiritual Stones
If the Door Of Time is expected to be opened, you need to have all three spiritual stones in your inventory. They cannot be found, and as such must be crafted.

Kokiri's Emerald Recipe:

![Kokiri's Emerald Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/26b71d0ee3c92e2071816fc6f45c3ddfe8447f94.png)

Goron's Ruby Recipe:

![Goron's Ruby Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0184852343a190dcbc4e4bbfa13d1db6b94fcdb.png)

Zora's Sapphire Recipe:

![Zora's Sapphire Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/11a1119537b374b8535d7d1ee05641e7b44d9c38.png)

When the Door Of Time is opened, the information inside can be used to finish your quest.

![Chamber Of Time](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9259fb06c26ef80b4182ba219438e8a86126503.png)

# Goddess Flames
WARNING: The flames MUST be collected IN ORDER! You cannot upgrade your sword unless it meets the requirements of the flame you're using.

First, make it to the end chambers of Farore's Labyrinth to recieve Farore's Flame.

![Farore's Flame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d21645c63d252159a01422b27255ad102e4770aa.png)

Second, find Nayru's Flame hidden somewhere in Nayru's Fountain.

![Farore's Flame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1e695541d89eea6ab5a40310022c99c69531e35.png)

Finally, Make your way to Din's Arena. When you arrive, you will be greeted by King Stalfos.
Defeat him to claim Din's Flame...

![Din's Flame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e5390db17314a11c1875fefa447cb92b9977a5f6.png)

...and the Hylian Shield!

![Hylian Shield](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f32e18b49be168d126f3ff8131d23a0fa5bb2bcb.png)

# Upgrading Your Sword
After each flame is acquired, they can be used one by one to increase your sword's power!
Simply right-click while holding the flame while the sword is in your inventory and it will be upgraded.

Farore's Flame unlocks the Master Sword.
![Master Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f109be448982d32c330f6602d84f46a77a0b2554.png)

Nayru's Flame unlocks the Tempered Master Sword.
![Tempered Master Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8297f741ee9e931156d42c3b12c523b4c6ccba7.png)

Din's Flame unlocks the Awakened Master Sword.
![Awakened Master Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0bc00d9ff737367fdc88fd6aca8656740d563e56.png)


# Second Quest
However, your sword isn't quite at its full potential just yet! To get there, you need to obtain the Golden Power.

At each flame location, a relic of the gods is hidden!

Farore's Labyrinth hides the Triforce of Courage.
![Triforce Of Courage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e250d65ed09eae0dc934c76b17dd165719554d41.png)

Nayru's Fountain hides the Triforce of Wisdom.
![Triforce Of Wisdom](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41971c16c8f9ebf22bd465c014018c65104b12c8.png)

And Din's Arena hides the Triforce of Power.
![Triforce Of Power](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3093b42029d23477f05b9bf93028f67984fd54f.png)

Once all three pieces are in your inventory, they join into one, creating the completed
TRIFORCE!
![Triforce](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad37112ac2bc5f682b9c6d9f3857b9059971a080.png)

Just like with the Flames, if you right-click while holding the triforce, your sword is upgraded one final time.

![True Master Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d4a56e4c6a74e3647ecc83fb6bd17cc0a99aa05.png)
